theorems.name: Submission.constancy_local_of_mollified_const
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl n)) (u : (Eucl n → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ (a : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (b : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl n)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (a k)) → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → (∀ k, tsupport (a k) ⊆ K) → tsupport b ⊆ K → (∀ q : ℕ, TendstoUniformly (fun k x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (a k) x) (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q b x) atTop) → Tendsto (fun k => u (a k)) atTop (𝓝 (u b))) → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ R : ℝ), 0 < ρ → closedBall x₀ R ⊆ U → ∀ (ψ : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, Continuous (ψ k)) → (∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ closedBall 0 (r k)) → (∀ k, 0 ≤ r k) → (∀ k, ρ + r k ≤ R) → (∀ b : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → ∀ q : ℕ, TendstoUniformly (fun k x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (convolution (ψ k) b (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x) (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q b x) atTop) → ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution (ψ k) ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = c k * ∫ x in ball x₀ ρ, f x ∂volume) → ∃ c₀ : ℝ, ∀ b : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ ball x₀ ρ → u b = c₀ * ∫ x, b x ∂volume
